title: Input buffer gates
statement: For natural numbers $n,m$ and a map $s$ assigning to each index $i<m$ either an input index below $n$ or a Boolean constant, the input buffer is the list of $m$ gates obtained by applying the corresponding input-or-constant gate to each $s(i)$ in order.
hypotheses_covered: A map from indices below $m$ to input indices below $n$ or Boolean constants
